title: Hi-Res Audio Player & Tag Master Pro (.NET 8 / WPF / WinUI 3)
target_os: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (x64 Native Executable / Single-File Self-Contained .exe)
overview: An audiophile-grade high-resolution audio playback workstation, real-time spectrum analyzer, and comprehensive metadata tag editor built with .NET 8.0 / .NET 9.0, C# 12, WPF / WinUI 3 (Wpf.Ui Fluent Design), NAudio / ManagedBass (unmanaged ASIO/WASAPI low-latency output), and TagLibSharp. Delivers gapless playback for bit-perfect lossless formats (FLAC, ALAC, WAV, DSD, AIFF) and MP3s, multi-format ID3v2/Vorbis/MP4 metadata editing with album art embedding, M3U8 playlist management, and a high-frequency real-time FFT audio spectrum visualizer.
key_features: Bit-Perfect Low-Latency Audio Engine: WASAPI Exclusive and ASIO driver streaming via NAudio / ManagedBass delivering zero-resampling bit-exact audio reproduction for hi-res FLAC, ALAC, WAV, and AIFF files
Gapless Playback & Seamless Crossfading: Dual-buffer audio pipeline preventing inter-track silence or pops across live concert albums and continuous classical compositions

Comprehensive Metadata & Cover Art Editor: Integrated TagLibSharp engine for editing ID3v2.3/v2.4, Vorbis Comments, and MP4 atoms (Artist, Title, Album, Year, Track, Genre, Lyrics, Bpm) with high-res PNG/JPG cover art injection

Real-Time FFT Spectrum Analyzer & Visualizers: High-frequency Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) analysis calculating frequency bin magnitudes for rendering responsive 60 FPS spectrum bars, oscilloscopes, and peak-meter displays via SkiaSharp

Smart M3U8 Playlist & Library Organizer: Library catalog management with automated audio file scanning, custom M3U/M3U8 playlist creation, quick search filtering, and smart tag-based playlist generation
ReplayGain & Dynamic Volume Normalization: Automatic ITU-R BS.1770 / EBU R128 loudness scanning and ReplayGain tag application for consistent volume across mixed playlists without audio clipping

core_stack.gui_framework: WPF / WinUI 3 with Wpf.Ui (Fluent Dark Theme / Windows 11 Mica Glass Effects)
core_stack.audio_engine: NAudio (v2.2+) / ManagedBass (Bass.Net v3.1+) with WASAPI Exclusive / ASIO support
core_stack.metadata_tagger: TagLibSharp (v2.3+) for ID3v2, Vorbis Comments, FLAC, and MP4 tag manipulation
core_stack.graphics_and_visualizer: SkiaSharp.Views.WPF (v2.88+) for 60 FPS audio spectrum visualization rendering
core_stack.packaging: MSBuild / dotnet publish (PublishSingleFile=true, SelfContained=true, IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true producing standalone ~45MB .exe)

design_system_and_theme.theme_name: Audiophile Amber & Onyx Obsidian (Windows 11 Mica / Fluent Grid)

typography.font_family: Segoe UI Variable Display, Cascadia Code, Inter, sans-serif

system_architecture.pattern: Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) with Unmanaged WASAPI/ASIO Audio Pipeline
system_architecture.ui_layer: WPF / WinUI 3 XAML markup with Wpf.Ui Fluent dark controls, SkiaSharp spectrum canvas, ID3 tag inspector drawer, cover art dropzone, and M3U8 playlist sidebar
system_architecture.background_services: Asynchronous WASAPI/ASIO audio playback threads, TagLibSharp batch tag writers operating off the main UI thread, and background FFT frequency analysis loops
system_architecture.ipc_and_event_bus: System.Threading.Channels (Channel) streaming atomic FFT sample arrays directly to the SkiaSharp visualizer canvas at 60 FPS without Dispatcher lag
system_architecture.process_safety: Strict unmanaged audio driver resource cleanup (IWavePlayer.Dispose(), AudioFileReader.Dispose()), safe file handle unlocking before metadata writing, and buffer overflow protection

ai_agent_prompt:
You are an elite Senior Desktop Audio Systems & Software Engineer tasked with implementing a production-grade native C# / .NET 8 desktop application titled 'Hi-Res Audio Player & Tag Master Pro'.

### PROJECT OBJECTIVE:
Construct a zero-dependency, audiophile-grade high-resolution music player, real-time audio spectrum analyzer, and metadata tag editor using .NET 8.0 / .NET 9.0, C# 12, WPF / WinUI 3 (Wpf.Ui Fluent Design), NAudio / ManagedBass (WASAPI/ASIO), TagLibSharp, and SkiaSharp. Enables users to play lossless FLAC/ALAC/WAV audio gaplessly, inspect and write ID3v2/Vorbis metadata tags with high-res cover art, manage M3U8 playlists, and visualize audio frequencies in 60 FPS without UI freezing.

### MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. .NET 8.0 ARCHITECTURE & MVVM PATTERN:
   - Built with C# 12 and .NET 8.0 LTS using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm ([ObservableProperty], [RelayCommand]).
   - Styled using Wpf.Ui applying Fluent Dark theme tokens (#05070A dark background, #F59E0B audiophile amber primary accent, #10B981 emerald green secondary accent) with Windows 11 Mica glass visual effects.

2. BIT-PERFECT LOW-LATENCY AUDIO ENGINE & GAPLESS PLAYBACK:
   - Implement WASAPI Shared/Exclusive and ASIO output modes via NAudio or ManagedBass for bit-exact reproduction of FLAC, ALAC, WAV, and MP3 tracks.
   - Build a dual-buffer queue pipeline ensuring zero-gap transitions between consecutive tracks in a playlist.

3. METADATA TAG EDITOR & COVER ART INJECTOR:
   - Integrate TagLibSharp to inspect and write ID3v2.3/v2.4 tags, Vorbis Comments, and MP4 atoms (Title, Artist, Album, Year, Track, Genre, Lyrics, ReplayGain).
   - Provide a cover art dropzone allowing users to extract, replace, or embed album artwork directly into audio files.

4. 60 FPS REAL-TIME FFT SPECTRUM VISUALIZER:
   - Execute real-time Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) analysis on audio playback sample streams.
   - Stream FFT bin magnitude arrays to a SkiaSharp canvas rendering responsive 60 FPS spectrum bars or oscilloscope waves without locking the WPF UI thread.

5. SINGLE-FILE PACKAGING:
   - Deliver complete C# source files (MainWindow.xaml, MainWindow.xaml.cs, MainViewModel.cs, AudioPlaybackService.cs, TagEditorService.cs) and a ready-to-publish .csproj configured for PublishSingleFile=true self-contained .exe output.
